# mcp-healthcare-reference — docs

The stakeholder pages for
[chief-builder/mcp-healthcare-reference](https://github.com/chief-builder/mcp-healthcare-reference),
a home-lab reference implementation of an enterprise MCP (2026-07-28) platform
for healthcare. Served by GitHub Pages at
<https://chief-builder.github.io/mcp-healthcare-reference-docs/>.

**Do not edit this repository by hand.** Every file here is written by the
source repo's `mirror-docs` workflow on each push to its `main` that touches
`docs/`: `index.html`, `.nojekyll`, `showcase/`, `walkthrough/`, and this
README (from `.github/docs-mirror/README.md` in the source repo). Changes made
here are overwritten on the next mirror. Open issues and pull requests against
the source repository.

All patient data shown or referenced is synthetic (Synthea); no real PHI.
